newsitem.title: USA: Conseco sees earnings from Transport deal.
newsitem.headline: Conseco sees earnings from Transport deal.

text.p: Conseco Inc said Thursday its planned purchase of Transport Holdings Inc is expected to add about $0.07 per fully diluted share to its 1997 earnings.

"This transaction, which is expected to add approximately seven cents to Conseco's 1997 earnings per fully diluted share, will strengthen Conseco's leadership in supplemental health insurance by adding approximately $110 million of annual premiums and $600 million of assets," Conseco Chairman Stephen Hilbert said in a statement.
He added that the deal also will give other Conseco insurance companies the opportunity to expand distribution of their products through Transport's network of career and independent agents.

Earlier, the two companies said they agreed to a merger, under which Conseco would acquire Transport for about $70 a share in Conseco common stock. The total value of the transaction is about $311 million.
